title: The Three Eternal Works and the Three Plagues at the Consummation
description: Two paired three-fold treatments of the consummation. The Three Eternal Works fashioned in the Light: the new shining land, the binding of darkness's fire, the sealing of sinners in the final clod. The Three Plagues against the Enemy across three cosmic ages: cosmogonic binding in the Living Principle, the Great Fire that releases and gathers inward, and final splitting (male into the bolos, female into the tomb) with the stone set forever between Light and Darkness.
